objective: 候補選定の74h複合条件とOI 60分変化について、設定・計算・ランキング・UI・runtimeの意味を一致させる。
broader_goal: Bitget Public market dataだけを使うlocal-first監視専用watchdeckをコード完成候補かつ初期runtime適格へ進める。
plan_goal: 74h三値ANDをCandidateだけへ接続し、Watchlistの広い監視面を維持する。OIを5分bucket・24時間retentionで既存DuckDBへ保存しexact 60分前bucketから状態を算出し、欠損はUNKNOWN、UNKNOWNは無加点とする。最小UI/version/docs/testsを同期し、one-command startup、finite live、restart、reconnect、artifact semanticsの初期runtime qualificationまで完了する。
deliverables: exact 60m OI wiring and UNKNOWN no-score
minimal Candidate and Monitoring Rail UI

acceptance_criteria.description: 74h component conditions use three-valued logic and composite is true only when both are true.
Single-condition matches, insufficient history and zero baseline never produce composite true.
Price and turnover match reasons are independently present in reasonCodes.
Candidate rankings include only composite true rows while Watchlist rows and noTrade diagnostics remain available.
OI samples are idempotently stored in 5-minute buckets and older than 24 hours are pruned.
OI compares to the exact 60-minute target bucket and missing reference yields UNKNOWN.
UNKNOWN OI receives no positive Attention Score contribution.
Candidate displays active thresholds and selected-symbol OI 60m state without a Watchlist column.
featureVersion and rulesetVersion are 3 while schemaVersion remains unchanged.
Existing DB initialization is additive and rollback does not require dropping the new table.
Existing monitoring behavior passes the full local verification gate.
Current docs, ADR and living plans match final implementation and evidence.
Stale or invalid current ticker OI is not sampled or compared and produces UNKNOWN.
One-command fixture startup renders the principal monitoring workflow and new semantics.
Isolated finite live smoke succeeds without modifying production state.
Runtime stores at least one valid OI sample and same-bucket writes are idempotent.
Controlled restart reuses additive OI history and preserves monitoring state.
Reconnect, resubscribe and ticker/candle ingest recovery are proven by focused test.
Artifacts prove Candidate/Watchlist/null-history responsibility separation.
Final full gate and diff audit pass with no unresolved P0/P1.

non_goals: Watchlist columns or full UI redesign
new market data channels or private API
new production OSS or DB/framework replacement
natural 24-hour disconnect as blocking synchronous gate
scope_in: OI local history and exact lookup
facts: baseline commit is the initial monitoring-only release
Candidate rankings do not use the 74h composite
service snapshots do not provide previous OI to the scanner
current DTO already exposes long-horizon and OI state fields
inferences: 5-minute OI buckets with 24-hour retention are sufficient and bounded
controlled reconnect tests are a practical mandatory gate while natural 24-hour disconnect remains operational observation
assumptions: volume means USDT quote turnover in this wave
Candidate means primary-rule matches and Watchlist means broad monitoring universe
holdingAmount remains the public OI source
unknowns: actual DuckDB service store path and API
